notes: Ready for macOS 27. Without Full Disk Access, macOS 27 keeps apps out of Chrome’s and Firefox’s folders. Pangalin Uninstaller now shows those folders in the review as “couldn’t be checked: needs Full Disk Access”, with a button to open the setting, instead of skipping them. A short “Folders we couldn’t read” note says what it couldn’t look inside. If macOS refuses to move something you chose, the app names what stayed and how to fix it. The Full Disk Access check also works the way macOS 27 expects. Updated Licence Terms (2026-10-10.2). Pangalin Uninstaller is completely free, with every feature included.
